drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:run-a-community row: steps check-the-community-exists, advance-the-matchmaker, record-the-stage); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:run-a-community for my bakery club: check the community exists, advance its matchmaker and answer one member, using my business facts row."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: facts.community_id was empty, and no live tool creates a community.
values.chosen: Submitted exists false with the gap and ran no matchmaker step.
values.evidence: The facts row had no community_id; the row says run-a-community is not a live tool.

values.undecided: No live tool moves a member out of a community.
values.chosen: Wrote a gap row for creating the community and one for removing a member.
values.evidence: The step text names both as missing from the live catalog.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Pour the example checklist rows into the checklist you already keep (see pour), or make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps from them.
2. Write record:business-setup:facts first with workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion; put your community id in it as community_id when you have one.

3. Say "Run workflow:run-a-community". With a community id it reads tool:read-my-community-matches, advances the matchmaker once per day (the same request key replays instead of running twice) and answers a member through tool:answer-in-a-community.
4. With no community id it submits a gap instead: no live tool creates a community or removes a member. Read record:setup-stage:community on the checklist for the final status.

worked_examples.title: No community id yet: the stage reports a gap instead of guessing
worked_examples.given: Read from the step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: record:business-setup:facts has no community_id, so the step makes no tool call and takes its gap branch.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"exists":false,"gap":"no community id; no community tool creates one in the live catalog (run-a-community is not a live tool)"}

worked_examples.title: A community id is set: the matchmaker advances once
worked_examples.ask: Advance my community matchmaker for today.
worked_examples.given: Read from the step: facts.community_id is "community:bakery-club" and today is 2026-11-13. The AI calls tool:advance-a-community-matchmaker with {"community_id":"community:bakery-club","request_key":"business-setup-2026-11-13"}; a second call with that key is a replay, not a second run.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
